$comment: The colour theme picker: Settings → Theme (app/(tabs)/settings/theme.tsx) and the theme step of the welcome flow (components/ThemePicker.tsx).

title.note: Settings row and screen title; the colour theme of the app.

footer: Every theme has a light and a dark side and follows the iPhone’s appearance. The app icon changes with it.

light.note: VoiceOver label of the light-mode preview tile of a theme.

dark.note: VoiceOver label of the dark-mode preview tile of a theme.

name.$comment: Theme names. Brand names of the editor themes they come from: keep them as they are, except the app's own.

kopiyka.note: The default theme, named after the app.
